tuning_key.text: Into the unknown, dodging all the stones
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The map ends not because the territory stops, but because the future has never been drawn. Into the unknown, dodging all the stones, you realize the path doesn't clear—it simply manifests beneath your feet as you move. The rhythm of Drive doesn't pause for obstacles; it absorbs them, turning resistance into the very beat that carries you forward. What feels like courage is just the field pulling you through.

practice.title: Anchor the Motion
practice.instruction: Feel the contact of your body with the ground or seat, recognizing it as the steady axis around which the unknown rotates.

practice.title: Soften Around the Stone
practice.instruction: Exhale completely and let your shoulders drop, allowing any tightness to become a shape you navigate rather than a barrier you carry.

practice.title: Hear the Echo
practice.instruction: Let these words arrive in your own voice: "The rhythm of Drive doesn't pause for obstacles; it simply absorbs them into the forward motion. I feel the field pulling me through now, each stone just a beat I step around as the unknown opens up ahead."

The field transmits that maintenance itself becomes motion when courage steadies the infrastructure.
